name: vex
description: Uses Gemini-API to take agent generated code/applications and creates educational and interactive quizzes so developers can understand how the agent created their code and learn how to recreate it.

commands.title: VEX: Generate Quiz from Current File

chatParticipants.name: vex
chatParticipants.description: Summarize observable coding-agent changes for a VEX quiz

commands.name: summarizeChanges
commands.description: Summarize the observable changes from this VEX chat session

vex.context.maxDepth.description: Maximum dependency-analysis depth for related workspace context.

vex.context.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of related files inspected during local analysis.

vex.context.maxRelatedFiles.description: Maximum number of ranked related files included in the Gemini context.

vex.context.maxRelatedSourceCharacters.description: Total character budget for related source excerpts sent to Gemini.

vex.context.maxSourceCharactersPerFile.description: Maximum source characters retained per discovered related file.

vex.context.maxSymbols.description: Maximum active-file symbols inspected for local references and definitions.

vex.context.maxSourceCharacters.description: Maximum source characters selected for the Gemini prompt.

vex.context.maxContextFiles.description: Maximum distinct files represented in the Gemini prompt.

vex.context.maxContextSymbols.description: Maximum symbols represented in the Gemini prompt.

vex.context.maxEstimatedTokens.description: Approximate maximum tokens for the compact context sent to Gemini.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
